title: Warmly Steamed Dutch Jerusalem Artichokes Pilaf
description: A hearty and nutritious Dutch-inspired dish featuring crisply steamed Jerusalem artichokes, perfect for a comforting lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Dried Thyme
ingredients.notes: fresh thyme can be substituted if available

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: use a low-sodium salt for best results

ingredients.name: White Wine Vinegar
ingredients.notes: for a tangy, slightly sweet flavor

instructions: Preheat the bamboo steamer to high heat, ensuring the bottom is filled with water, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, peel the Jerusalem artichokes and cut them into 1-inch pieces.
In a large bowl, toss the artichoke pieces with the olive oil, thyme sprig, salt, and a pinch of pepper until well-coated.
Transfer the artichoke mixture to a baking sheet and roast in a preheated oven at 425°F for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Once the artichokes are done roasting, transfer them to the steamer basket and steam for 10-12 minutes, or until tender.
In a small saucepan, heat the ghee over low heat until melted.
Add the white wine vinegar to the ghee and stir to combine.
To assemble the pilaf, place a portion of steamed artichokes on a plate, drizzle with the ghee and vinegar mixture, and garnish with fresh parsley.
